<div class="card-body">
'''Lift Tube''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Transport|Transport Vehicle]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">リフト・チューブ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">４名の乗客を運べる。屋内の移動要塞の位置カードにのみ配備／移動できる。人員なしでの移動が可能。戦闘およびフォース消耗へのリアクションとして、動ける範囲で移動できる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型で、垂直水平両方向に高速で移動する輸送シリンダー。宇宙ステーションや、デス・スターなどで使用されている。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lift Tube.

'''Card text:''' May carry four passengers. May deploy and move only at interior mobile fortress location cards. May move without personnel. May move within range as a reaction to a battle or Force drain.

'''Lore:''' An enclosed transport cylinder that travels rapidly in vertical and horizontal directions. Used in space stations, the Death Star, and similar places.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to interior mobile fortress location cards, while the English says interior mobile sites. The Japanese lore mentions space stations and the Death Star; the English also explicitly mentions large starships.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lift Tube (Dark)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=267s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:27.</ref>
